proves.claim: With read.thinCommands on, show of an item with a receipt, a frozen bar and a last refusal prints the same lines and exit code as with it off.

cli.io-show-thin.receipt-bar-refusal-equ.why: Without it, a regression where with read.thinCommands on, show of an item with a receipt, a frozen bar and a last refusal printed other lines than with it off would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: The thin show door returns null for an item with a thread entry.

cli.io-show-thin.thread-entry-steps-asid.why: Without it, a regression where the thin show door served an item with a thread entry would pass unnoticed.
